== English Special Edition comparison ==
In print, the device was unrestricted and retrieved 2 Force. Decipher restricted it to two copies and reduced the retrieval to 1. In December 2016, the Players Committee specified that the device drawing the card is the one that can retrieve for it. The 2013 slip corroborates the earlier game text and has incorrect lore, so the earlier infobox uses the verified printed lore and no image.
